reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking local vibrational heterogeneities to suppressed low-frequency modes and enhanced phonon scattering, though the claimed >30% improvement in RMSE is an arbitrary quantitative target not derived from physical principles.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, using combinatorial sputtering and TDTR, with a well-defined falsification criterion (RMSE >30% deviation), though the exact measurement of LDOS in thin films is experimentally challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful for researchers in this field, as it proposes a concrete, high-throughput experimental-computational framework to discover low-thermal-conductivity HEAs, directly addressing the research question.
